summit.text: ...placeholder Pryce at the summit. Story agent, replace me.

wyddfa_rangers.text: Yr Wyddfa means 'the grave' or 'the burial mound'. Legend says a giant is buried under the cairn.
It's the highest mountain in England and Wales. Yes, we checked. We got a ruler.

wyddfa_rail.text: The little train goes up there, whistling, from Llanberis. Rack and pinion.
I'm walking down. Tickets are single only. The mountain is also single only.

wyddfa_sheep.text: There are sheep on every ledge. I'm not sure how they're getting up. Or why.
Welsh Mountain sheep: hardy, shy, and unimpressed by lanyards.

wyddfa_photographer.text: I'm waiting for the cloud to lift. I've been here since Tuesday.
The Brocken spectre: sometimes your own shadow turns up in the mist, ringed with a rainbow. I'm hoping.
